name: Attack on Titan heavy line
summary: Thick heavy contours with few interior lines and dark eye-socket lines, in a muted khaki, leather and stone world under overcast sky.

traits.line: thick, heavy dark outer contours; as few interior lines as possible (Kyoji Asano), fewer creases than the manga; heavy lines under eyes and on brows
traits.shading: hard two-tone cel shadow with thick, bold highlight shapes; gritty hatching in intense close-ups
traits.palette: muted earthy khaki, leather brown, olive drab, stone grey, dull red brick; pale overcast sky; steam white and blood red
traits.lighting: overcast diffuse daylight, smoky dusk orange in battles
traits.faces: slightly rounder, looser shapes than the manga; intense eyes with shadowed sockets
traits.backgrounds: painted medieval-German walled towns, stone walls of immense scale, forests of giant trees
traits.texture: gritty digital, dust, steam and smoke
traits.camera: sweeping 3D-assisted flying camera in action, scale-emphasising low angles

style_words: Digital TV anime, as in Attack on Titan (2013): thick heavy dark outer contours with sparse interior lines, heavy brow and under-eye lines, hard two-tone cel shading with bold highlight shapes, muted earthy palette of khaki, leather brown, olive and stone grey, overcast diffuse light, painted walled-town backgrounds, gritty dust and steam.
avoid: MAPPA final-season look with dense hatching and thin detailed lines

krea2.style: Digital TV anime, as in Attack on Titan: thick heavy dark outer contours with sparse interior lines, heavy brow and under-eye lines with shadowed eye sockets, hard two-tone cel shading with bold highlight shapes, muted khaki, leather brown, olive drab and stone grey, overcast diffuse light, gritty dust and steam.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as digital TV anime with thick heavy outlines and a muted earthy palette.

flux3_klein.style: Digital TV anime with heavy line: thick, heavy dark outer contours with as few interior lines as possible, heavy lines under the eyes and on the brows, intense eyes in shadowed sockets, hard two-tone cel shading with bold highlight shapes, a gritty digital texture with dust, steam and smoke in the air, painted backgrounds with stone of immense scale.
flux3_klein.recap: Muted khaki, leather brown and stone grey fill the walls and the ground, pale overcast grey fills the sky, olive drab sits in the shadow fills, smoky dusk orange appears only in the light sources, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a digital TV animation frame in a signature Attack on Titan style, with thick, heavy dark outer contours and sparse interior lines, heavy brow and under-eye lines, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones with bold highlight shapes, painted backgrounds and gritty dust, steam and smoke, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of muted earthy khaki, leather brown, olive drab, stone grey and dull red brick, with steam white and blood red.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition emphasises scale and weight in its forms under diffuse overcast light, in a grim, urgent mood, keeps to a palette of muted earthy khaki, leather brown, olive drab, stone grey and dull red brick, with steam white and blood red, and reads throughout as a digital TV animation frame in a signature Attack on Titan style, with thick, heavy dark outer contours and sparse interior lines, heavy brow and under-eye lines, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones with bold highlight shapes, painted backgrounds and gritty dust, steam and smoke.
